name: workspace-switcher
description: Status bar buttons that open the .code-workspace files in a folder.

workspaceSwitcher.folder.description: The folder with the .code-workspace files that get a button each.

workspaceSwitcher.order.description: Workspace names in the order their buttons stand, from the left. Workspaces not named here follow alphabetically.

workspaceSwitcher.showClose.description: Show the cross that closes the open workspace, before the buttons in the status bar.
